shared_requirements.placement: Below compact hero and above editorial content
shared_requirements.map_purpose: Orient users to the district and nearby alternatives; do not imply precise boundaries.

map_hero.title: Downtown Oakland
map_hero.subtitle: East Bay institutional business core with BART, civic, and professional office context.
map_hero.qa_note: Must not read as all of Oakland.

image_requirement.alt_text: Downtown Oakland commercial streetscape in Oakland, CA
image_requirement.desired_subject: Broadway, City Center, or civic-core office streetscape with visible commercial buildings.

map_hero.title: Uptown Oakland
map_hero.subtitle: Mixed-use Oakland office district with Broadway, Lake Merritt, arts, food, and BART context.
map_hero.primary_focus: Broadway / Franklin / Webster / Lake Merritt edge
map_hero.qa_note: Must distinguish Uptown from Downtown Oakland.

image_requirement.alt_text: Uptown Oakland commercial streetscape in Oakland, CA
image_requirement.desired_subject: Broadway or Uptown mixed-use commercial blocks with office, storefront, and street activity.

map_hero.title: Downtown Palo Alto
map_hero.subtitle: Walkable Peninsula downtown with startup, professional office, retail, and Caltrain context.
map_hero.primary_focus: University Avenue / Hamilton Avenue / Lytton Avenue
map_hero.qa_note: Do not fold Stanford Research Park or California Avenue into the core district.

image_requirement.alt_text: Downtown Palo Alto commercial streetscape in Palo Alto, CA
image_requirement.desired_subject: University Avenue, Hamilton Avenue, or Lytton Avenue low-rise office and retail streetscape.
